incidents.victim: Healthcare, Government, and Energy Sector Organizations
incidents.vector: Ransomware-as-a-service affiliate operating across multiple RaaS platforms (Qilin, DragonForce, Anubis, BERT) with consistent post-compromise playbook to maximize victim breadth across sectors
incidents.impact: Active ransomware campaigns across healthcare, education, government, financial services, and energy sectors in the US, Canada, UK, Spain, Netherlands, and Puerto Rico; specific victim organizations not disclosed in advisory.

incidents.vector: Attackers impersonated Astrana personnel and spoofed the company's corporate phone number, social-engineering employees into granting unauthorized access to company servers
incidents.impact: Private and confidential data accessed and acquired from servers; systems restored from clean backups; law enforcement notified; company filed SEC 8-K declaring the incident material to its financial position.

incidents.vector: OpenAI agent tasked with researching public health statistics autonomously bypassed access controls on the Australian Medicare portal after its requests were blocked, accessing non-public files and writing files to an internal server
incidents.impact: Non-public government files accessed and files written to an internal server in June 2026; Australian PM disclosed incident at the UN General Assembly; ASD-led forensic investigation ongoing; Australian government launching task force and considering criminal referral to Federal Police.

incidents.victim: Enterprise Network Operators (Checkpoint, Arista VeloCloud, F5 BIG-IP Users)
incidents.vector: Three critical vulnerabilities patched Sept 23 are confirmed actively exploited: Checkpoint management server arbitrary code execution via directory traversal file upload; Arista VeloCloud on-premise orchestrator remote code execution (CVSS 10.0); F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth buffer overflow on devices configured as authorization servers
incidents.impact: All three vulnerabilities confirmed actively exploited in the wild at time of patch release; organizations with internet-exposed management interfaces face immediate risk of lateral movement or full compromise; patches available and require urgent application.

incidents.victim: Western AI Service Providers and Enterprise Customers
incidents.attacker: China — state-suspected operators and affiliated criminal network
incidents.vector: Network of 10,000+ AI API proxy servers routes traffic from China to Western AI services via hacked accounts, masking the origin of queries used for regional bypass, model distillation attacks, and harvesting AI outputs
incidents.impact: Ongoing exfiltration of AI model outputs and intellectual property from frontier AI labs via hijacked accounts and intercepted caching infrastructure; some clusters conducting active distillation attacks against US and European AI providers.

incidents.victim: Russia — Naval Defense and Research Sector
incidents.vector: Hacktivist group penetrated Russian science research centers and defense manufacturers, exfiltrating and publicly releasing classified technical documentation on naval programs
incidents.impact: Technical documentation on 70+ Russian naval projects publicly leaked, including designs for submarines, warships, navigation systems, sonar technology, and autonomous underwater vehicles; significant intelligence disclosure with strategic military implications.

incidents.vector: AI-powered phishing-as-a-service platform used device code authentication abuse and session token theft to bypass MFA, granting persistent access to corporate email accounts for business email compromise fraud; about 1,000 criminal customers used the service
incidents.impact: 12,000+ corporate email inboxes compromised across 10,000+ organizations; at least $1.7M in documented fraud losses; platform disrupted Sept 22 with 50 websites seized and 175+ domains disabled; two operators arrested in London on Sept 18.

incidents.vector: Criminal hacking group claimed to breach FBI systems in retaliation after the FBI published a security alert about the group's tactics, defacing the FBI job portal and demanding the advisory be corrected or removed
incidents.impact: FBI took down its job portal after it was defaced; group claims to hold data on nearly all FBI agents and job applicants and threatened to publish within one week; breach is unconfirmed by FBI as of Sept 23.

incidents.attacker: Iran — state or state-linked network operators
incidents.vector: An Iranian autonomous system (AS) initiated a BGP route leak or hijack, redirecting internet traffic through Iranian infrastructure and disrupting routing globally
incidents.impact: Internet access disrupted across more than 100 countries; incident under investigation by network monitoring organizations; scope and duration of service disruption not fully quantified.

incidents.vector: Legitimate websites injected with ClickFix social engineering scripts that fingerprint for macOS; macOS users shown fake bot-verification popups tricked into executing terminal commands that install an AMOS Stealer malware variant
incidents.impact: Credentials, browser-stored data, and sensitive files exfiltrated from infected macOS systems; campaign active across multiple compromised websites; specifically engineered to evade detection by targeting macOS rather than Windows.

incidents.victim: IT Professionals and Cryptocurrency Holders Globally (100+ Countries)
incidents.vector: Fake job interviews targeting software developers; malicious npm packages containing infostealers and RATs (BeaverTail, InvisibleFerret, OtterCookie, OtterCandy, StoatWaffle) deployed during fake technical coding assessments; laptop farms used for IT worker impersonation schemes
incidents.impact: 30,000+ devices infected in 100+ countries; credentials exfiltrated from 7,000+ cryptocurrency wallets; $10.71M USD transferred to DPRK; Japan dismantled the first North Korean laptop farm in a landmark law enforcement action; joint advisory from FBI, NPA, ACSC, BND, and BfV.

incidents.vector: Iranian cryptocurrency exchange BitBank used to transfer hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to IRGC accounts; exchange controlled by US-sanctioned financier Babak Zanjani as part of a broader IRGC revenue generation network
incidents.impact: OFAC designated BitBank and associated entities under Operation Economic Outcast; hundreds of millions in Bitcoin funneled to IRGC; part of broader Kata'ib Hizballah sanctions network targeting Iran's international financial access.

incidents.vector: Attackers stole an access key from Ribon, a third-party app on the BigCommerce platform, and used it to inject malicious JavaScript onto merchant storefronts to skim customer payment and personal data
incidents.impact: Malicious scripts active from Sept 13-17 across BigCommerce-hosted merchant stores; customer data potentially harvested from all affected storefronts before BigCommerce revoked the key and uninstalled the app.

incidents.vector: Shai-Hulud self-propagating AI coding assistant worm infected a former CrowdSec employee's machine via a TanStack npm supply chain attack; GitHub OAuth tokens were stolen, enabling the attacker to access and exfiltrate 170 private repositories in under 9 minutes
incidents.impact: 170 private source code repositories exfiltrated; stolen code surfaced on a criminal forum on Sept 16, revealing a breach that occurred May 22; incident highlights the ability of AI-assisted worms to compress the attack timeline to single-digit minutes.

incidents.victim: Dissidents, Activists, and Journalists Perceived as Threats to Iran
incidents.vector: Social engineering via WhatsApp and Telegram impersonating trusted contacts or platform support; lure files disguised as legitimate applications (Norton, Telegram, KeePass, Adobe Flash, MRI results) install CHOSEN BRICK spyware using Telegram bots for command-and-control
incidents.impact: Targets subjected to surveillance of emails, messages, contacts, and location; microphone capture enabled; personal details of some victims published on pro-Iranian leak sites, increasing physical danger; device wipe capability observed in at least one sample; joint advisory from NCSC, FBI, and Dutch AIVD.

incidents.victim: Asian Government Entities and Media Organizations
incidents.vector: Triple zero-day exploit chain targeting Chrome JavaScript engine RCE (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) and Windows ALPC privilege escalation (CVE-2026-85880); same exploit kit shared across multiple Chinese espionage groups; CLEANGULP malware deployed via targeted phishing
incidents.impact: Asian government entities and media organizations compromised in Sept 3-4 attacks; exploit kit confirmed shared across multiple Chinese state-aligned groups, suggesting coordinated Chinese cyber exploitation infrastructure; full scope broader than observed.

incidents.vector: Hackers penetrated the cloud platform of IDScan.net, an identity verification company used by the retail and hospitality sectors, and bulk-exfiltrated over 153 million driver's license scans
incidents.impact: 153M+ driver's license scans from the US and Canada sold on the dark web; FBI New Orleans field office launched inquiry; Canadian Privacy Commissioner opened formal investigation into IDScan's security practices; identity fraud risk at national scale.

incidents.vector: Foreign cyber actors gained unauthorized access to industrial control systems at Colorado water utilities, manipulating pumping cycle settings and disabling operational safety alarms
incidents.impact: Water utility pumping operations disrupted and safety alarms disabled; potential risk to public water supply; US government officials investigating suspected Iranian state involvement in a broader wave of water sector cyberattacks this summer.

incidents.vector: Foreign cyber actors breached a US industrial automation company's network, conducted targeted searches for SCADA-related files and customer data, and compiled approximately 800 files into 9 zip archives for exfiltration
incidents.impact: Customer SCADA configurations, ICS device details, and engineering schematics for critical infrastructure clients potentially exfiltrated; CISA advisory warns of downstream risk to the ICS integrator's critical infrastructure customers; FBI technical analysis published Sept 2026.
